sloka: आपाते पक्षिसंघानां पक्षिराज इव व्रजन् ।हनुमान् मेघजालानि प्रकर्षन् मारुतो यथा ॥५-१-८०॥
transliteration: āpāte pakṣisaṁghānāṁ pakṣirāja iva vrajan ।hanumān meghajālāni prakarṣan māruto yathā ॥5-1-80॥

translations.english: Hanuman was found pulling clusters of big clouds along with him like the Windgod and appeared like Garuda,the king of birds, drawing flocks of birds along with him at the time of landing.
